name: qa_drive
title: OS-INSFX-FX1, the Drive effect module (modules/effects/drive, kind 2) as a track insert from the console: loaded from the card, bound with `diag ins`, heard, its tail ends at once, and its cost read with `diag bench insert` (bench image). Console only: the insert is NOT saved (S3), and the console has no insert parameter verb, so the drive sweep is a hand check once the Mixer's INSERTS page and the parameter page exist (S4, S5). Needs modules/effects/drive.tmod on the card (the build's modules/drive.tmod, copied by the tester). Reset the unit first so that drive is the only effect module loaded (`diag bench insert` times the first loaded effect). Writes nothing to the card. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX-FX1, rows QA-GLB-174, 175 and 176 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; QA-GLB-175 is a host test). Put modules/effects/drive.tmod on the card, reset the unit so that no other effect module is loaded, and open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a sounding track 1). The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3). The default setting is SOFT, drive 12 dB, tone 8 kHz, mix 100 %, output 0 dB: track 1 must sound driven, louder and compressed, as a saturated copy of itself

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-174: the packed module passes the loader on the unit
QA-GLB-174: loaded, version 1.0.0; `mod` also says where its hot part runs (the SRAM_L slab or SDRAM): read it against the hot size of the build
QA-GLB-174: bound to track 1, slot 1, with its default parameters
QA-GLB-174: the insert runs (phase on) and its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line (the figure the spec estimates at 0.7 % [est] (about 1.9k cycles a block settled))
QA-GLB-174: the load with the insert on; underruns 0; read it against the same project with no insert
QA-GLB-174: nothing was forced to dry

steps.say: QA-GLB-174, by ear: track 1 sounds saturated (drive 12 dB, SOFT: louder, compressed, the peaks clipped soft, no aliasing hiss at this drive, no zipper noise, no clicks); the other tracks are unchanged. Then `ins bypass 1 1 on`: the full sound returns with no click

steps.note: QA-GLB-174: bypass is the host's one-block ramp to dry
QA-GLB-174: off resets the module (shutdown, init) and the effect starts from silence: no thump
QA-GLB-174: a second and a half after the stop there is no `tail` word: the drive returns 0 once its state is under -140 dB (the DC blocker's pole is 0.995: a few ms at these settings)
QA-GLB-174: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the drive bound and idle

expect: BENCH insert \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(.*, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-176: bench image (`-DO3OS_BENCH=ON`), transport stopped, drive the only loaded effect: `insert_effect` is the settled render() of 64 frames, `insert_effect_mod` the same with set_param on the Drive every block (a sweep: smoothing and the derived values recomputed each block), `insert` the whole insert with the adapter. Quote min, avg and max in cycles and as a share of the 261,225-cycle block against the budget (docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 rows)

steps.say: QA-GLB-176: copy the four BENCH lines (min / avg / max) into docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 rows, and into the module's README; the cap of four instances stays or is lowered from them (spec section 6)
